Speak to the miners and investigate what Kournan troops are doing in the area.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* Required Hero: [[Master of Whispers]]

===Objectives===
* Query miner [[Lahri]] about suspicious activity around the quarry.
* Find out if miner [[Moh]] has witnessed anything strange lately.
* See if miner [[Kurli]] has noticed anything unusual recently.
* See [[Belgun the Quarry Master]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Trade Contract]]

==Walkthrough==
No fighting needed for this quest. Simply walk over to each of the miners and talk to them.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Belgun the Quarry Master'''
:''"I see the Master of Whispers has brought with him some reinforcements. Some of my miners have noticed Kournan troops snooping around, though in truth we don't know why they're here or what they're looking for. Scout out the area and see what you can find out for me, will you? Speak to the '''miners''' and gather what '''information''' you can. Start with Lahri, he complains a bit, but he's the reliable sort."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = A fact-finding mission? In a mine? Say no more!
|decline = Mine? I think this job is YOURS.
|ask = Probe the miners for information regarding the '''Kournan troops'''. Start with '''Lahri'''. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Lahri'''
:''"Kournan troops? I ain't seen nothin'. You better check with Moh; he's the brains of this outfit."''

'''Moh'''
:''"Lahri sent you? Why I oughta.... Listen, I haven't seen a thing. Go bother Kurli, though you might have to let your knuckles do the talking."''

'''Kurli'''
:''"Oh yeah, I saw troopers...they were sayin' somethin' about scriptures. I couldn't quite make it out, though."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Belgun the Quarry Master'''
:''"Scriptures? That's not a good sign at all. Things seem to just get worse around here. My two closest assistants, Lenahn and Jenahn, have just gone missing. I have a bad feeling the Kournans are behind it as well."''

==Trivia==
The miners in this quest are named after [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three_Stooges the Three Stooges], and their in-game quest comments match catchphrases from their Stooge counterparts.
